sources.title: Critter — Critter Electronics
sources.excerpt: The Critter Electronics Model III Overdrive is described by the builder as a Blues Breaker design with a charge pump for high headroom. Rather than using a single transistor boost after the Blues Breaker section, the design uses a charge-pump-powered two-stage preamp with individual internal controls. A toggle provides a Hi-Cut function that can be useful with higher-gain settings. The builder presents the Model III as a beefier take on the Blues Breaker concept.

sources.title: Critter - Model III Overdrive (Blues Breaker on Steroids.)
sources.excerpt: A Critter Electronics Reverb listing identifies the exact Model III Overdrive and describes a 7660S charge pump that generates internal 18V operation from a standard 9V supply. The listing says the design adds a two-stage amplified preamp after the Blues Breaker section and includes an internal gain trim. It identifies the model as an overdrive made in the United States, with the photos representing the listed unit.
